name: Herod The Great
overview: Herod the Great is depicted in Scripture as the reigning king at the time of Jesus’ birth, whose reign was marked by fear and violent attempts to maintain power. Matthew 2 reveals Herod’s wrath when he perceives the wise men’s visit as mockery, leading to the tragic massacre of Bethlehem's young children. Additionally, Luke 9 shows Herod the tetrarch grappling with confusion and fear over the ministry of John the Baptist and Jesus, highlighting his troubled response to God's unfolding plan.
